patch.value: GH-677: pm-path relocation must diagnose extension discovery changes

GitHub issue https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/677 reports that --pm-path silently relocates extension discovery and extension commands vanish without a targeted diagnostic. Make storage and source discovery coordinates explicit and actionable.
